## Publication Information

**Date:** 1897

**Genre:** Fiction (modern)

**Publisher:** <i>Friendly Leaves</i> (July 1897) 232-4.

**Notes:** In the form of 2 letters sent from 'Langley' showing contrasting responses to the country: one bored, one enchanted.
